title: Folding Fraction Strips
objective: Specify and partition a whole into equal parts, identifying and counting unit fractions by folding fraction strips.

problems.text: Circle the strips that are folded to make equal parts.
Fill in the blanks: There are ___ equal parts in all. ___ are shaded.
Noah, Pedro, and Sharon share a whole candy bar fairly. Which of your fraction strips shows how they each get an equal part? Draw the candy bar below. Then, label Sharon's fraction of the candy bar.
To make a garage for his toy truck, Zeno bends a rectangular piece of cardboard in half. He then bends each half in half again. What fraction of the original cardboard is each part?
Zeno bends a different piece of cardboard in thirds. He then bends each third in half again. Which of your fraction strips best matches this story?
